verdict.rationale: Context.dev ships a CLI, SDKs and an MCP server, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never documents such a setting. The only 'opt out' mention concerns websites asking to be excluded from scraping, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
